derivation: from (sullen) and a derivative of G3700 (ὀπτάνομαι);
def: angry-visaged, i.e. gloomy or affecting a mournful appearance

occurrences.text: Moreover when ye fast, be not, as the hypocrites, of a sad countenance: for they disfigure their faces, that they may appear unto men to fast. Verily I say unto you, They have their reward.
